newsitem.title: USA: Democrat Wellstone keeps Minnesota Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Democrat Wellstone keeps Minnesota Senate seat.

text.p: Democrat Paul Wellstone won a second Senate term and handed a repeat defeat to former Republican Sen. Rudy Boschwitz in a rematch of their 1990 Minnesota race, television networks projected Tuesday.

Wellstone, one of the most liberal members of the Senate, championed the increase in the minimum wage and health care reforms that passed in the last congressional session. He was the only Democrat up for re-election to vote against a landmark welfare reform bill signed by President Clinton.
